Generate a Combined Barcoding HTML Report

render_report_barcode.Rd

Generate a Combined Barcoding HTML Report

Usage

render_report_barcode(
  bold_jsonl,
  blast_json,
  fasta,
  metadata = NULL,
  key_col = NULL,
  aligned = TRUE,
  output_file,
  description = as.character(Sys.Date()),
  mafft_args = NULL
)

Arguments

bold_jsonl

Character. Path to a BOLD JSONL result file.

blast_json

Character. Path to an NCBI BLAST JSON result file.

fasta

Character. Path to a sequence FASTA file.

metadata

Optional data.frame containing sequence/specimen metadata. Default is NULL.

key_col

Unquoted column name in metadata matching sequence names. Default is NULL.

aligned

Logical. If FALSE, aligns fasta via mafft() before rendering. Default is TRUE.

output_file

Character. Path where the final HTML report should be saved.

description

Character. Title or description of the run. Default is as.character(Sys.Date()).

mafft_args

Character vector or NULL. Additional arguments passed to mafft() when aligned = FALSE. Default is NULL.

Value

Invisibly returns the normalized path to the generated HTML file.

See also

Other report: render_report()
